summary.value: The Smith - Lincoln Square is the brasserie at 1900 Broadway at 63rd Street, across from Lincoln Center.

description.value: The Smith - Lincoln Square is an American brasserie at 1900 BROADWAY (AT 63RD STREET). Its posted hours are Mon - Thurs: 8AM - 11PM and later on weekends. It sits right across from Lincoln Center, so it is a handy choice before or after a show.
